title: TimeSeriesIntelligence
description: Intelligence data for an IP in the timeseries dataset

first_seen.description: The earliest date GreyNoise observed any activity from this IP.

last_seen.description: The most recent date GreyNoise observed any activity from this IP.

found.description: Indicates if the IP was observed scanning the GreyNoise sensor network. Also referred to as 'noise'.

tags.description:
A list of activity/malware tags GreyNoise has applied to this
IP.

actor.description: The overt actor this IP is associated with.

spoofable.description: This IP address has been opportunistically scanning the Internet, however has failed to complete a full TCP connection. Any reported activity could be spoofed.

classification.description: The classification of the IP address, either "benign", "malicious", or "unknown", based on the activity observed by GreyNoise.

cves.description: A list of CVEs associate with this IP.

vpn.description: This IP is associated with a VPN service. Activity, malicious or otherwise, should not be attributed to the VPN service provider.

tor.description: Whether or not the device is a known Tor exit node.

last_seen_timestamp.description: The timestamp of the last observed activity from this IP.
